note: Route A is a performance modification, not a defect fix. It changes no physics. Classification is provenance of the path, not of the value.

bit_identity.statement: One further modification hoists the geometry parse out of the sub-fan loop. It changes no physics: on a full 10-replica reference set computed with the unmodified engine, all 144 dose arrays are SHA-256 identical and the scored VOI values are bit-identical.

cpu_two_beam_check.detail: same Route A definition on the CPU target: two off-axis sub-fans from L40 replica 00 inputs; standalone vs @manifest dose .raw SHA-256 identical; geometry parsed once

L40_K4_anchor.detail: one MC-GPU process per (projection, sub-fan) beam; the production K=4 40 cm anchor

L160_K4_length_arm.detail: one MC-GPU process over @manifest; geometry parsed once; per-beam tallies. Bit-identical to Route B on the L40 reference, so the path does not change the scored values.

L40_routeA_bit_identity_check.role: not an anchor; demonstrates byte-equality against Route B replica 00 at the same seed
